annotations.title: Submit a template for WhatsApp review

description: Creates a new WhatsApp message template and sends it to Meta for review. This leaves Cosend: Meta reviews every template (a decision can take up to 24 hours), and a rejection counts against the WhatsApp account’s quality history. It submits only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it submits nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it submits. Ten a day per workspace. The categories: marketing makes people aware of the business, its offers and sales; utility follows up on something the customer did or asked for (an order, a booking) and may not promote anything, so an order update with a discount in it is marketing; authentication is a one-time code. A wrong category is moved or rejected by Meta. Meta’s answer shows in the template’s review status. It sends no message to anyone.

add_security_recommendation.description: Whether Meta adds "For your security, do not share this code." to the body.

button.description: Refused. WhatsApp writes the button label in each language; there is no text to set. Give delivery instead: {"type": "copy_code"}.

code_expiration_minutes.description: Minutes the code stays valid, 1 to 90: Meta's footer "This code expires in N minutes." Left out or null, there is no footer.

delivery.description: How the code reaches the person: {"type": "copy_code"}, or {"type": "one_tap" | "zero_tap", "apps": [{"package_name": "com.example.app", "signature_hash": "K8a/AINcGX7"}]} (1 to 5 apps); zero-tap also takes "zero_tap_terms_accepted": true.

apps.description: The Android apps the code is handed to: 1 to 5, Meta's supported_apps.
The Android apps the code is handed to: 1 to 5, Meta's supported_apps.

zero_tap_terms_accepted.description: Meta's zero_tap_terms_accepted: "Set to true to indicate that you understand that your use of zero-tap authentication is subject to the WhatsApp Business Terms of Service." Sent to Meta and recorded in the audit log.

languages.description: The language versions to create, e.g. ["fr", "en_US"]: one template per language, each written by WhatsApp in its language. On an edit, left out or exactly the template's own language.

message_send_ttl_seconds.description: How long WhatsApp keeps trying to deliver the message: 30 to 900 seconds, or -1 for 30 days. Left out or null, WhatsApp's default for authentication, 10 minutes.

authentication.description: An authentication template, in Meta's shape, in place of components and language: {"languages": ["fr", "en_US"], "add_security_recommendation": true, "code_expiration_minutes": 10, "delivery": {"type": "copy_code"}, "message_send_ttl_seconds": 600}. WhatsApp writes the message and the button label in each language ("{{1}} is your verification code." in English); there is no text to set. One template is created per language, each its own resource; the answer is the version in the first language. Required when category is authentication, and refused on any other category; null is the same as leaving it out.

components.description: Meta's components; required on every category but authentication, which takes authentication instead. A HEADER carries its format (TEXT, IMAGE, VIDEO, DOCUMENT or LOCATION), and a header without one is sent as TEXT. An IMAGE, VIDEO or DOCUMENT header's sample is a file uploaded with POST /v1/media, named by its id in Meta's own field: {"type": "HEADER", "format": "IMAGE", "example": {"header_handle": ["med_…"]}}. The file must be a JPEG or PNG image of at most 5 MB, an MP4 video of at most 16 MB, or a PDF of at most 100 MB (WhatsApp's limits), and Cosend uploads it to Meta and sends Meta's handle in its place; a handle from Meta itself is sent as it is. A LOCATION header takes no sample, and only a utility or marketing template can have one.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

display_name.description: The human name, free text (e.g. "Order shipped"). When name is left out, the system name is generated from it: lowercase, accents dropped, every other run of characters an underscore, at most 512 characters, with _2, _3… added when a template on the WABA already has that name.

example_values.description: A sample value for every variable in the TEXT header and the body, keyed per component by the name between the braces: {"body": {"1": "Pablo", "2": "860198-230332"}} or {"body": {"first_name": "Pablo"}}. Required for each such variable, because Meta rejects a template without samples; a missing one is refused with invalid_request, param example_values. Sent to Meta as each component's example. A component that already carries Meta's own example and has no entry here is sent as it is.

language.description: The language, e.g. "en_US". Required on every category but authentication, which takes authentication.languages instead.

name.description: The system name, used as given. Optional: leave it out and it is generated from display_name. Give it to add a language to an existing template. One of name and display_name is required.
